sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this work, we introduce Qwen3, the latest series in our foundation model family, Qwen. Qwen3 is a collection of open-weight large language models (LLMs) that achieve state-of-the-art performance across a wide variety of tasks and domains.
